Story & Plot

Following their previous adventures, Mario and Luigi face a new threat when Bowser Jr.princess-naps Rosalina in an effort to free his imprisoned father Bowser. Alongside Princess Peach and new companions like Yoshi and Fox McCloud, the brothers travel across the stars on a galaxy quest. The film is a loose adaptation of the 2007 Nintendo video game.

Comedy & Entertainment

The film brings back the wahoo moments and colorful sparkle of the Nintendo franchise to entertain young audiences. It relies on family-friendly interactions and space-faring antics as the heroes race across the multiverse. While some find the sequel to be an unhinged cosmic mess, others note moments of visual inspiration.

The voice cast features Chris Pratt as Mario, Charlie Day as Luigi, Anya Taylor-Joy as Princess Peach, Jack Black as Bowser, and Brie Larson as Rosalina. Reviewers highlight Donald Glover's vocal work as Yoshi as a likely highlight of the film, alongside the established performances of the returning main cast.

  • Colorful sparkle and visual inspiration
  • Sweet family interactions

Weaknesses

Reviewers note that the film can feel like a cosmic mess and an incoherent sequel that lets characters stagnate into bland affability. The loose adaptation struggles with its narrative throughline, leading to a disappointing experience for some viewers compared to the original.

Final verdict

The Super Mario Galaxy Movie offers enough colorful sparkle and wahoo moments to entertain young audiences and families. However, its unhinged narrative and uneven execution make it a mixed experience for older viewers. It is recommended primarily for families and fans looking for casual video game nostalgia.

Story & Plot

Science teacher Ryland Grace wakes up on a spaceship light years away from home with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As his memory slowly returns, he realizes he must solve the mystery of a substance causing the sun to die out and save Earth from extinction. Along his space journey, he travels toward a distant star and encounters a surprising extraterrestrial being whose own world is under threat.

Comedy & Entertainment

Reviewers note that the storyline features funny and emotional moments that enhance the overall entertainment value. The sci-fi adventure maintains a well-paced narrative that relies on its engaging characters and relationship dynamics rather than forced gags. The witty undertones and lighthearted beats complement the heavier existential stakes of saving the universe.

Performances & Direction

Ryan Gosling delivers one of the best performances of his career as Dr. Ryland Grace, earning widespread praise for his grounded and compelling portrayal. The cast also features Sandra Hüller, James Ortiz, Lionel Boyce, and Milana Vayntrub supporting the narrative. Additionally, the character Rocky stands out as one of the most lovable creations put on screen in years.

Strengths

  • Ryan Gosling's career-best performance
  • Engaging and lovable character Rocky
  • Brilliant space scenes and visuals
  • Focus on friendship and sacrifice
  • Well-paced narrative across its runtime

Weaknesses

A small number of critics offered more measured takes, noting that the film occasionally tries to balance too much. Nitpicks and minor quibbles also point out that it leans into a more unhurried and relaxed cinematic vacation style rather than a relentless sci-fi thriller.

Final verdict

Project Hail Mary is a brilliant, emotional space adventure that succeeds as aspirational blockbuster cinema. With stellar lead performances and a heartfelt core about friendship and sacrifice, it easily ranks among the best science fiction adaptations in years. Highly recommended for fans of the genre and moviegoers looking for a memorable cinematic journey.
